_setup_instructions.dev_tracking_uri: Tracking server URI for the dev environment (e.g. http://localhost:5000 from scaffold-dev-tracking.sh)
_setup_instructions.staging_tracking_uri: Tracking server URI for staging (empty until phase 2 stands it up; may equal dev_tracking_uri when one server hosts all environments)
_setup_instructions.prod_tracking_uri: Tracking server URI for prod (empty until phase 2; may equal staging_tracking_uri on a shared server)
_setup_instructions.registry_namespace: Team/domain segment used in registered-model names, e.g. 'growth' produces dev.growth.<model_name>
_setup_instructions.model_name: The business problem's model name, e.g. churn_classifier — combined as <env>.<namespace>.<model_name>
_setup_instructions.experiment_name: MLflow experiment name for training runs, e.g. churn-classifier
_setup_instructions.serving_url: Base URL of the served model once phase 5 runs it (e.g. http://localhost:5001); used by verify.sh's serving assertions
